notes.title: List of updates in version 2.3.5
notes.content:
- New expansion "Secrets & Lies" available: 
Discover 6 new suspects, 6 new locations and 6 new items. And for the first time, experience a brand new game mode, thanks to the 18 story cards which are able to replace items for ever more mystery-filled games!
- AI improvements based on analytics of users decisions
- Tweaking psychic AI in story mode when the player is the ghost
- Various Bug fixes

notes.title: Updates in version 2.2.1
notes.content:
- In the lobby, it's now possible to switch freely between waiting screen and join screen without leaving the game.
- Cards from all different promos and expansions can be enabled through Additional Content screen.
- Steam binding - it's now possible to automatically login to the bound Asmodee account.
- Minor graphic updates.
- Interface, localization and other bug fixes.

notes.title: Join the new beta of Mysterium!
notes.content:
Dear mediums,

We’re working on the next update for Mysterium and would like to have your feedback. Interested? Follow this link to apply to the closed beta: http://forums.asmodee.net/topic/2-how-to-apply/
You'll receive an invitation when the playtest will start (we're aiming for mid next week).

[h1]Beta patchnotes:[/h1]
- Reworked lobby flow - it's now possible to switch freely between waiting screen and join screen without leaving the game
- Reworked game creation screen - cards from all different promos and expansions can be enabled through Additional Content screen
- Reworked join screen - expansions are now displayed as a graphical icon
- Steam binding - it's now possible to automatically login to the bound Asmodee account or unlink the account
- Profile preview - added optional close button for EOU
- Small UI consistency fix - blitz AI displayed with a portrait and included in AI count in the join screen
- Added text reminder about enabled cards being available to all game participants regardless of DLC ownership
- Localization fixes

We hope you'll like these changes!

notes.title: Updates in version 2.1.2
notes.content:
- Added free extra content - cards and soundtrack - unlockable through various secret in-game actions.
- Added Russian and Ukrainian localization.
- Added online saves using your Asmodee account.
- Reworked in-game waiting for players screen.
- Rule changed - limited time for decision during shared vision and straw poll (4 minutes by default) in multiplayer.
- Rule changed - in blitz mode if a psychic didn't choose any card, the first card available is selected.
- Various bug fixes.

notes.title: Updates in version 2.0.6
notes.content:
- Introduced new game mode - Pass & Play! Play together with your friends on the same device.
- Added ability to create password protected games.
- Added ability to add AI bots to all multiplayer modes during game creation.
- Added profile preview for Players in the lobby. 
- Added social features: friends, ignored and recent Players.
- Added chat emoticons.
- Games in progress are displayed in the lobby.
- Various bug fixes.

notes.title: List of updates in version 1.0.30
notes.content:
- Introduced new way to communicate with other Players: Telepathy! Refer to the in-game "How to Play" section for more details.
- Reworked and rebalanced inactivity detection.
- Ghost can assign and unassign vision cards with double click.
- Exact time of message is now displayed in lobby chat.
- Minor UI adjustments.
- Various bug fixes and performance improvements.

notes.title: List of updates in version 1.0.24
notes.content:
- The idle players will be replaced by an IA player after some time of inactivity.
- Added an option in the option menu to ease performance for the devices with low CPU speed by removing some visual effects (but 1Gb RAM still necessary).
- Updated leaderboard so that the player score is always visible.
- Miscellaneous bug fixes.

notes.title: Release notes for version 1.0.16
notes.content:
Language is now automatically adapting on the system language
Added an icon to represent who the player is
Removed “P” glitch in the chat
Improvement of the chat log messages
Fixed a bug where the ghost assigns 0 vision cards
Notification popup added in phase 2 when the ghost assigned cards to the players
Magnifier functionality added in culprit phase
The tutorial has been improved with more steps
Added a text in the help to explain how is managed the vote draw during the culprit phase
The help text image bug is now fixed

Improvements of the chat functionality:
The "C" Key opens the chat window as a shortcut
Increased contrast of colors in the chat
It is now possible for the mediums to chat during the culprit phase until the ghost has sent cards to the mediums
The ghost can now expand the chat tab to see more text
The ghost is labelled in italic in the chat

Story Mode:
Removed wrong text at the end of case 1
Fixed an issue that might allow the players to control another medium than Nathan in the story mode case 4 and 5
Fixed an issue with the clock timer in the case 7 turn 1

Various bug fixes
